historicalFindingPreserved: The sources found do not provide a follow-along-specific instruction for selecting the preferred Region, eu-west-2. The learner instructions should explicitly tell the learner to confirm eu-west-2 in the AWS Management Console or use the AWS CLI global --region eu-west-2 option, but this exact regional setup guidance was not taken from a proposed source.
activeIamFindingPreserved: A least-privilege IAM policy document should be manually reviewed before inclusion. The Service Authorization Reference confirms the relevant actions and the queue ARN resource type, but policy construction—especially the resource scope required for sqs:CreateQueue and any console-dependent permissions—should not be inferred without additional sourced authorization guidance.
